units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 22:6">Gen. R. s. 22</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 5:18">Is. V, 18</cite>) <he>כק׳ הזו של ספינה</he> (prob. to be read <he>עגלה</he>) as the rope of a ship (a wagon), v. <cite ref="P00036"><he>עֲבוֹת</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>קְלָעִים</he>.
<cite ref="Yoma 47a:13">Yoma 47ᵃ</cite> <he>מימי … קִלְעֵי שערי</he> never did the beams of my house see the plaits of my hair (I always wear a cap in the house).
